title: Authority topology
root_cause: Federated effect gates and runtimes lack one explicit topology tying effects to authority, evidence, rollback, bypass detection, and conformance.
source_requirement: Create a machine-readable authority topology without forcing a single-language runtime.
implementation_steps: Inventory effect types and authoritative gates.
Bind language/runtime owners, receipts, rollback, bypass detection, and tests.
affected_tests: Architecture invariants, provider, work admission, skill promotion tests.
evidence_required: Complete effect inventory and conformance-owner receipt.
rollback: Remove topology consumers and retain current explicit gate implementations.
acceptance_criteria: Every effect type has one declared authoritative gate and rollback owner.
Federated implementations share an evidence contract.
